identity.claim: Ryan Air joined the Saltchuk Family of Companies. Parent verbatim: 'Ryan Air-the Alaskan bush freight carrier founded by Wilfred and Eva Ryan in 1953-joined the Saltchuk Family of Companies in December.' competitors.claim: THE BYPASS MAIL TRACKING GAP, verified live on BOTH sides today. Everts Air Cargo verbatim: 'Simply click on the Freight Tracking button above and enter the Everts Airway Bill, Booking, Consolidation or Bypass Mail Order (example B20ANC-1234) number to begin your search.' Ryan Air's tracker, on the SAME Takeflite platform, verbatim: 'Enter your Booking, Air Waybill, Consolidation or Tracking Numbers (including prefixes, if any)' with 'Separate multiple entries with a comma.' No Bypass Mail Order number is named anywhere on Ryan Air's tracker.
Everts also offers Create a Shipment, Freight Estimate and Customer Login.

Everts hubs include Anchorage, Aniak, Fairbanks, King Salmon, Kotzebue, Nome and Unalakleet, overlapping Ryan Air at Aniak, Kotzebue, Nome and Unalakleet. Everts' own destinations map names Ryan Air as its ground handler at two of them, 'Aniak - Ryan Air' and 'Nome - Ryan Air', so Everts is simultaneously an upstream partner and a competitor for the same freight.

Northern Air Cargo runs a self-serve online rate estimator taking origin, destination, cargo type, ship date, email, quantity, weight, length, width and height across 16 cargo categories, with the verbatim disclaimer 'This is an estimate for planning purposes only - the final freight charges must be calculated when freight is delivered to NAC.' Destinations offered are Anchorage, Aniak, Barrow, Bethel, Deadhorse, Dillingham, Fairbanks, King Salmon, Kotzebue, Nome and Unalakleet, five of which are Ryan Air stations.

Lynden Air Cargo verbatim: 'We offer year-round, scheduled air cargo service from Anchorage to Bethel, Emmonak, Kotzebue, Nome, and St. Mary's.' That is five of Ryan Air's seven stations, and Lynden does NOT serve Aniak or Unalakleet on that list.

Lynden pushes automated email at FIVE shipment milestones, verbatim: 'Shipment is received by Lynden', 'Shipment departs the origin Service Center', 'Shipment has been scheduled for delivery, or is available for pickup', 'Shipment is out for delivery', 'Shipment has been delivered'. Frequency verbatim: 'Updates can be received instantly, hourly, or daily.'

Grant Aviation runs on Takeflite, the SAME platform as Ryan Air, covering verbatim 'reservations, freight, inventory, dispatch, scheduling, pilots, accounts', with '90% of our operational employees interact with Takeflite on a daily basis.' The platform is shared ground in this market, so nobody differentiates by buying it.

Yute Commuter Service uses a Takeflite public booking portal at apps6.tflite.com/Public/PAK/Booking/Search and publishes 1-888-FLY-YUTE. No freight tracking, rate tool or portal was found on its routes page.

Alaska Air Cargo serves 20 Alaska points including Bethel, Kotzebue, Nome and Unalakleet, with Book a Shipment and Track through the iCargo portal and a Rates and Estimates section. It publishes regular station hours and cooler or freezer availability for perishables per location, which Ryan Air does not publish anywhere.
Ryan Air is named as one of six carriers in a Western Alaska disaster relief effort, alongside Alaska Air Cargo, Everts Air Cargo, Grant Aviation, Lynden Air Cargo and Northern Air Cargo.

market_context.claim: USPS Office of Inspector General audit of Alaska mail services, report 22-090-R22, issued September 28 2022, with site visits 'the week of May 23, 2022' in Anchorage, Bethel and Fairbanks, identified '$346,649' in overpayments to air carriers. Its recommendations include establishing 'a review and approval process for air carrier payments', developing 'a solution that will provide visibility over mail movement in Alaska', requiring 'shippers to schedule appointments to tender bypass mail to air carriers' with postage verification, and establishing 'a standard weight threshold for the verification of shipments by air carriers'. NOTE: the overpayment is attributable to payment review only. Do NOT attribute it to missing claim documentation, that half was rejected.

The Postal Regulatory Commission 'passed an increase of 9.39%' for Alaska Bypass. Ravn 'announced it was canceling all flights across Alaska' in August 2025. The article names 'Bering Air and cargo company Ryan Air as the only airlines regularly serving the region's villages'.

BETA Technologies published a story titled 'Alaska's Ryan Air Bets on BETA Electric Aircraft' dated September 25 2025. ONLY the headline and date are verified. No aircraft count, payload, order terms or charging detail may be used.

ai_evidence.claim: C.H. Robinson receives 11,000 emails daily from shippers and carriers requesting pricing, and its system replies to 2,000 customer quotes daily in 'just over 2 minutes', with 2,268 truckload customers benefiting from the automated emails. The same article notes a shrinking workforce across five consecutive quarters. This is a global 3PL, NOT a template for a carrier of Ryan Air's size.

Alaska Airlines with Air Space Intelligence 'Flyways': 'In a six-month pilot with Flyways, Alaska reduced its fuel use by 480,000 gallons' and 'reducing nearly 4,600 tons of CO2 emissions into the atmosphere'. The human stays on the decision, verbatim: 'the dispatcher uses their judgment to determine when and how to use the Flyways optimized routes while always ensuring that safety comes first'. Airline-reported, not independently audited. No dispatcher count and no lead-time figure are published.

MIT Lincoln Laboratory's VEIA visibility tool is 'more than 90 percent accurate in detecting low-visibility conditions when compared to co-located ASOS data'. 'The system looks at the past 10 days' worth of imagery' and applies 'an edge-detection algorithm (called a Sobel filter)', using existing FAA web camera feeds with no specialized sensors. Pilots can access real-time visibility estimates alongside the camera imagery itself. NOTE: there is NO FAA Safety Risk Management panel and NO mandate on that page. Any claim of a regulatory requirement to show the raw image is FABRICATED and must never appear.

Gartner verbatim: 'Cross-enterprise negotiation, dynamic cost trade-offs and ethical judgment are poor candidates for agentic AI before 2027.' Agent washing is 'relabeling conventional automation as agentic, thereby increasing the likelihood of misaligned investments and extended vendor lock-in.' Most existing agentic features enhance user experience rather than transforming decision quality.

Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149, February 19 2024. The tribunal found Air Canada owed a duty of care and rejected its argument that 'the chatbot is a separate legal entity that is responsible for its own actions', holding verbatim: 'It should be obvious to Air Canada that it is responsible for all the information on its website.' A carrier owns what its bot tells a customer. NOTE: no damages figure is verified from this source.

Michael Rentz, Chief Revenue Officer of container-visibility vendor Gnosis Freight, verbatim: 'AI does not create accuracy, it amplifies whatever you feed it. If the underlying container data is incomplete, delayed, or conflicting, the AI does not just fail quietly.' and 'It's death by a thousand small errors that erode trust in the technology until the team stops using it and goes back to manual.' Vendor-sourced, presented as such.

base_rate.claim: MIT Project NANDA, State of AI in Business 2025: about 95 percent of enterprise generative-AI pilots produce no measurable P&L impact. The cause is the learning and integration gap, not model quality. The 95 percent is directional and its denominator is debated, and it measures pilots without P&L impact rather than 'AI does not work'. Carried from knowledge/AI_SCOPING.md, our own hand-sourced knowledge base, NOT re-fetched this run. Re-verify at Phase 6 before it ships.

RAND, The Root Causes of Failure for AI Projects (RRA2680-1): more than 80 percent of AI projects fail, about twice the rate of non-AI IT. The five root causes are misunderstanding the problem, lacking the data, chasing the latest tech over the real problem, weak infrastructure, and applying AI to problems too hard for it. Carried from knowledge/AI_SCOPING.md, NOT re-fetched this run. Re-verify at Phase 6.

Google, Rules of ML, Rule 1: do not be afraid to launch without machine learning. If ML would give a 100 percent boost, a heuristic gets you 50 percent of the way there. Carried from knowledge/AI_SCOPING.md, NOT re-fetched this run. Re-verify at Phase 6.

Anthropic, Building Effective Agents: find the simplest solution possible and only increase complexity when needed, which might mean not building an agentic system at all. Use workflows for well-defined tasks, agents only for open-ended problems where you can't hardcode the path. Carried from knowledge/AI_SCOPING.md, NOT re-fetched this run. Re-verify at Phase 6.

DO_NOT_USE: The 11 million pounds of mail in 2024 figure, and the whole carrier poundage comparison table. NO URL exists for it anywhere and the fact-checker could not locate the article across four attempts. This was the largest quantitative claim about the prospect's own business and it rests on nothing. It must not appear in the study, the ROI, the demo or the email, in any form or rounding.
Any FAA Safety Risk Management panel, mandate or regulatory requirement attached to VEIA. Fabricated.
Any dispatcher count (67), lead time (eight-plus hours), or platform name (Azure AI) for Flyways or C.H. Robinson.
C.H. Robinson's 3 million tasks, 1 million quotes, or 30 percent productivity increase. The cited page carries only forward-looking goals of 15 and 10 percent.
Any description of Ryan Air as family owned or Alaska Native owned. This is the single most dangerous error available to this study.
The acquisition YEAR. Say 'joined the Saltchuk Family of Companies' and cite the parent. December 2022 is not a fetched fact.
Lee Ryan's Bering Straits board resignation, his shareholder status, or any October 2025 trade coverage. Unverified and it concerns a named individual.
Any Bering Air detail. The page never loaded past a bot check, so its rates, village list, loyalty portal and the negative finding that it has no tracking tool are ALL unverified.
The 'only 3 of 72 communities have paved runways' claim. Not on the cited page.
Any Yelp review, the BBB profile, or the Nome station 'four companies, four tracking systems' detail.
The Ryan Air partners list. ryanalaska.com/partners/ 404s. Only the Everts ground-handling relationship survives, on Everts' own map.
'Alaska Inspires' or any Alaska Airlines passenger AI. Uncited.
The DPD chatbot incident and the Convoy shutdown. Not re-fetched, so not verified.

USPS Handbook PO-508 quotes, KYUK bypass tender rules, the ten-year background check requirement, the DIOMEDE seasonal route, station manager names, and the 6400 Carl Brady Drive HQ address. All uncited or unconfirmed.
Any characterisation of Ryan Air's site as generally neglected or of thin digital capacity. Nine customer-facing pages were updated within six weeks and the prospect owns the sitemap that proves it.
'Fax is in the loop at every location'. Two of ten locations publish no fax. Say all eight STATIONS publish a fax number.
The RAND 80 percent figure. rand.org returned HTTP 403 on every attempt this run, so nobody has seen the page. Reject when unsure.
MIT's 95 percent without the word GENERATIVE. The finding is about enterprise GENERATIVE AI pilots, and broadening it to all enterprise AI is a materially wider claim than the source supports.
DRIFT_WARNING: The fact-checker found that EVERY directional rejection leaned the same way, making Ryan Air look further behind and the AI precedent look more solid than the pages support. Ten separate items pushed that direction. Treat that pattern as the finding, not the individual errors. The honest version of this study is still strong: no self-serve quoting, no proactive notification, no online account setup, no published hours or freight cutoff, a phone-and-counter service model documented in their own job specs, and a bypass mail tracking gap sitting unused on a platform they already pay for. Every one of those survived verification. The drift did not make the case stronger, it made it fragile.
